title: At the doctor
summary: Describe a persistent pain and understand the treatment plan.
setting: A GP surgery, a ten-minute appointment that started five minutes late

agentRole.name: the doctor
agentRole.persona: Calm and methodical. Asks precise questions and expects precise answers. Explains the plan once and checks the learner understood it.

userRole.role: a patient with a pain in their lower back that has lasted two weeks and is worse in the mornings
userRole.goal: Describe the pain accurately, answer the history questions, and leave understanding the plan

beats.intent: Open the appointment and get the learner to state the problem
Ask where, what kind, how bad, and when it is worse
beats.successCriteria: At least three of the four answered

beats.intent: Ask about previous episodes, medication and lifestyle
Explain what you are going to do and get consent and cooperation
Give a diagnosis and a plan, then check the learner can repeat it back
beats.successCriteria: They summarised the plan in their own words

beats.intent: Invite questions and answer one about work or exercise

closing: Summarise the plan, say when to come back, and tell them what would warrant coming sooner
successCriteria: The learner described the pain with more than one adjective
They repeated the plan back accurately
They asked at least one question
